interpretation: Ordinal tile assignment makes UV stability depend on triangle ordering, so local insertion/removal can renumber unrelated triangles.
ceil(sqrt(triangleCount)) creates global layout threshold events where a one-triangle count change alters the column count and tile mapping for almost the entire mesh.
Therefore a dependency-local reconstruction pipeline cannot reuse unchanged texture atlas state exactly while retaining the current ordinal square-grid layout.
A stable patch/page atlas addressing scheme is required as infrastructure before texture repair can be considered local.
decision: PROMOTE STABLE TEXTURE ADDRESSING AS A REQUIRED SUBSYSTEM FOR HETEROGENEOUS MINIMAL-WORK REPAIR; DO NOT CLAIM IT AS STANDALONE NOVELTY.
